description: List CRM follow-up tasks you may see (portal tasks, owned by users). Filter by status, owner ("mine" or ownerId), linked account, dueWindow overdue or today (company timezone), or exact dueAfter/dueBefore datetimes with a zone. Returns the true total and pages. Unassigned tasks cannot be filtered here.

accountId.description: Only tasks linked to this CRM account, if you can see it

dueAfter.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset or Z; inclusive lower bound

dueBefore.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset or Z; exclusive upper bound

dueWindow.description: overdue: due before now. today: due today in the company timezone. Both list open tasks only.

ownerId.description: Only tasks owned by this users.id. Company membership IDs do not match.

status.description: Task status: todo, in_progress or done

name: list_crm_tasks

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
